dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast, light-valued 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters are visible against a dark background. The most prominent is a conjoined double-annulus (figure-8) in the upper-left quadrant showing a sharp pixel-intensity gradient transition from dark-grey interiors to bright-white borders with irregular, jagged widths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters distributed across the upper dorsal surface, particularly concentrated in the anterior neck region and interspersed between the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse triangle is formed by connecting the centroid of the prominent figure-8 structure to the centroids of two distinct circular macro-annuli located posteriorly and superior-laterally on the dorsal mid-line.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique conjoined double-annulus structure resembling a numeral '8' is present in the upper-left dorsal quadrant, serving as a primary visual anchor.
